completedCoverage.finding: Jayden Daniels and Brock Purdy are the only passers in the official gamebook. Washington's Athan Kaliakmanis and San Francisco's Mac Jones are listed as did not play; Marcus Mariota and emergency third quarterback Kurtis Rourke are inactive. This closes game-day quarterback participation without inferring a starter loss from an inactive backup.

Washington's Matt Gay replacement Desmond Stevens, Tress Way and Tyler Ott and San Francisco's Eddy Pineiro, Corliss Waitman and Jon Weeks are listed among participants and recorded kicking, punting or snapping duty. Presence is certified; a numerical specialist loss remains governed by complete case coverage rather than omission.

The gamebook confirms Mike Evans, Gracen Halton, Mykel Williams, Siran Neal, Upton Stout and Kyle Juszczyk participated; Evans, Halton and Juszczyk were initial starters. It also confirms Deebo Samuel, Nick Bosa, Garret Wallow and Marques Sigle were inactive. These facts validate activation and game-day role inputs while preserving complete replacement and cluster review requirements.
